latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bid-reader skill.

- Extracts readable text from PDF, Word (.docx), and Excel (.xlsx/.xls) bid/tender documents.
- Simple command-line usage: bid-read <file-path>.
- Outputs plain text for search, summarisation, or further analysis.
- Supports invocation from OpenClaw UI or other agents.
- Handles PDF via pdfplumber, Word via python-docx, Excel via pandas/openpyxl/xlrd.
- Ignores unsupported formats; flattens tables and does not preserve complex formatting.
